## v1.2.0 — 2026-03-15

This release introduces major new capabilities including GitHub App integration, web dashboard, multi-repository aggregation, and comprehensive testing coverage. The release also includes security fixes, configuration validation, rate limiting, and marketplace preparation while maintaining v1.0.0 consistency across all components.

### ✨ Features

- Added GitHub App integration with web dashboard and multi-repository aggregation capabilities
- Implemented comprehensive testing suite with 76 tests covering publishers, collectors, and gate functionality
- Added rate limiting and configuration validation for improved API stability
- Introduced telemetry and CI Docker support for better monitoring and deployment
- Added pro tier functionality and marketplace preparation

### 🔧 Improvements

- Updated site integrations grid to reflect all v1.0.0 supported platforms
- Removed v1 badges from integration chips and discontinued GitBook documentation

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Applied security fixes and improved documentation alignment
- Fixed API server tests and widget build pipeline issues
- Fixed Bitbucket capacity warning implementation
- Resolved v1.0.0 consistency issues across configuration, action, README, and environment files

### Contributors

  • Added telemetry capabilities for usage tracking and analytics

  • Added pro tier functionality with enhanced features
